originals_policy: Preserve source bytes and public scorer; never repair golden silently

evidence: phase_dev/golden/ap.jsonl API004482: currency USD, net 240000; expense/payable journal 193767 EUR
decisions.convention: Document fields net/tax/gross/payable and AP lines.amount retain document currency. Journal debit/credit use company local currency. Store both currencies and conversions explicitly; IC amount may be EUR while adjustment is MXN.
decisions.acceptance: Separate document and local amount fields; FX provenance/date/rounding remain traceable; no blanket header conversion

evidence: POLITICAS_CONTABLES.md §1: conversion rounded per line; balancing difference absorbed by vendor/customer
FORMATO_ENTREGA.md: integer cents and ±2 cents journal comparison
decisions.convention: Use Decimal-based explicit calculation modes. FX rounds per line; vendor/customer absorbs rounding difference. PPA truncates. Scorer tolerance is a comparison allowance, never calculation policy.
decisions.acceptance: Test positive/negative rounding boundaries and PPA truncation; arithmetic remains integer cents after conversion

evidence: roadmap-auditado.md §3 and M3-12: historical investigation required
decisions.convention: Preserve this observed sign in audit evidence. Do not derive a general rule from an income account appearing on debit. Business explanation remains unresolved until historical FX/bank/journal evidence is reviewed in M3.
decisions.acceptance: M3 documents historical amount/rate evidence and explicitly resolves or retains this exception before bank reconciliation closure

decisions.convention: Keep individual close rows and journals; report both raw row count and scorer-key aggregates. Aggregate equality cannot prove per-item completeness.
decisions.acceptance: Comparator reports item differences and aggregate differences independently; no row is silently deduplicated

evidence: score.py task score functions and je_match
decisions.convention: Public score is preserved. Contract/comparator must additionally validate AP document_type/action and nonposted consistency; AR invoice date/currency/deductions; cash residual invoice and chronology; bank adjustment ownership/category/currency; IC amount/responsible; close individual rows/journal/date/cost object; balance dimensions beyond society/account.
decisions.acceptance: Teammate integration adds required-field and journal checks separately from scorer metrics; M0 stays open until these dependencies merge

decisions.convention: Validate company explicitly in every journal/adjustment and in balance impact. A journal with correct accounts and amounts in the wrong company must fail internal validation even if je_match accepts it.
decisions.acceptance: Negative fixture with wrong company fails contract/comparator; public scorer remains unchanged

evidence: roadmap audit: synthetic identifiers are not production tax identities
decisions.convention: Preserve raw NIF and use master/source identity correspondence. Do not reject a synthetic tax identity merely because a production checksum fails; recipient NIF presence and addressee identity remain required policy checks.
decisions.acceptance: Document facts retain literal NIF and provenance; no normalization overwrites source evidence

evidence: phase_dev/golden/ap.jsonl API004469, journal 1100-2026-5100000822: first 40700000 line partner=null; creditor V100121
decisions.convention: Preserve source golden; keep strict supplier-partner validation for account 40700000. Report this golden inconsistency explicitly rather than weakening policy or repairing source.
decisions.acceptance: Comparator exposes missing supplier partner as policy discrepancy; document the historical advance allocation evidence before AP closure
